# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `sojo` MCP server pointing at Sojo's hosted endpoint (`https://sojo.gg/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Sign in with X on sojo.gg.
- Logo: points to `https://sojo.gg/logo.png`; the site was unreachable when this plugin was added, so no local copy is committed.
